description: Signal library for Empire Revenue OS GTM layer. Each signal maps to a persona type, sequence type, and priority.

signals.name: New Founder Launch
signals.description: Founder recently launched a product, service, or brand. Needs GTM motion immediately.
signals.outreach_angle: You just launched — the fastest way to revenue is a sellable offer + outreach kit. We built that.

signals.name: Messy Offer But High Activity
signals.description: Business is active and engaged but offer is unclear or unpriced. Needs offer forge.
signals.outreach_angle: I see you're active in [space]. The missing piece is a clear paid offer. We can build one in 24 hours.

signals.name: Agency Selling Services Without Productized Offer
signals.description: Agency selling custom services without a repeatable package. Missing the productized revenue lane.
signals.outreach_angle: Most agencies leave 60% of revenue on the table by not productizing. We fix that.

signals.name: Creator With Audience But No Monetization Path
signals.description: Creator has built an audience but monetizes only through ads or sponsorships. Needs a product.
signals.outreach_angle: You have the audience — now you need the offer. We turn followers into customers in 48 hours.

signals.name: Local Business Posting About Slow Leads
signals.description: Local business openly discussing slow sales or needing more customers. High intent signal.
signals.outreach_angle: Saw you're looking for more leads. We build automated outreach systems for local businesses.

signals.name: Repo/Product Built But No GTM Motion
signals.description: Product exists in code but no go-to-market activity. Classic builder who can't sell.
signals.outreach_angle: You built it — now let's sell it. We handle the GTM so you can keep building.

signals.name: Website Has Only Landing Page / No Trial
signals.description: Business website is a static landing page with no way for visitors to experience value. No trial, no demo.
signals.outreach_angle: Your site looks great — but visitors can't experience value without a demo or trial. We fix that.

signals.name: Recent Funding/Application/Pitch/Deck Activity
signals.description: Business recently sought funding, applied to a program, pitched, or created a deck. Momentum signal.
signals.outreach_angle: Congrats on the recent momentum. Let's make sure your revenue system is ready for what comes next.
